description: Implementation of QuicConnectionMtuDiscoverer class for MTU discovery in QUIC protocol, including methods for enabling/disabling MTU probing, updating probe sizes, and internal state management.

classes.name: QuicConnectionMtuDiscoverer
classes.description: Class responsible for discovering the maximum transmission unit (MTU) size in QUIC connections through probing.

methods.name: QuicConnectionMtuDiscoverer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the MTU discoverer with probe parameters.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables MTU probing with specified maximum packet lengths.

methods.name: Disable
methods.description: Disables MTU probing and resets internal state.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if MTU probing is currently enabled.

methods.name: ShouldProbeMtu
methods.description: Determines if an MTU probe should be sent based on current state and packet counts.

methods.name: GetUpdatedMtuProbeSize
methods.description: Calculates and updates the size of the next MTU probe.

methods.name: next_probe_packet_length
methods.description: Calculates the next probe packet length based on current min/max bounds.

methods.name: OnMaxPacketLengthUpdated
methods.description: Updates internal state when the maximum packet length changes.
